Progress on #28

Prepare the R4 qualification plan from merged PR-B and persist the genuine
Issue28 v2 transition approval. This Draft PR contains only the activation
receipt, the pending plan and review documents. Production Python and the
Requirement snapshot are unchanged. Provider/paid/SEC calls remain **0/0/0**.

## Exact state

| Object | Identity |
|---|---|
| Base / merged PR-B | `75002a861555c91aeadd72260d98707225d96f49` |
| Base tree | `a1fa189d5a99194e1ebe6fbd495df48dcb3d5594` |
| PR-C head | `d3babd0ac0300d68dd58007e38caa2d7b2c27ab4` |
| PR-C tree | `751ade0961a40a2b09a052635f61b37919724a53` |
| Requirement | `issue_28_v2` |
| Closure | `sha256:5b7a386b7c95f8b9542a2251a94ec8d98876e7c833d49132364c77024b27ff9e` |
| Activation receipt | `sha256:2ef83cc98563975a536120b302c7b6427a89e8fa773de1276a83445f451bd108` |
| Pending plan | `sha256:215277ae679bde123e51cf3ce839445e9ef152c5a9f5d0c72f74a2b6618658bd` |

[Owner approval](https://github.com/wlvh/SEC_metrics/pull/30#issuecomment-5556855154)
was posted by `wlvh` at `2026-09-06T04:20:23Z`, following explicit authorization
in the owner conversation. The original text, URL, author, timestamp and hash
are in the validated independent receipt. The
[receipt comment](https://github.com/wlvh/SEC_metrics/pull/30#issuecomment-5556858500)
was preserved before PR30 merged. No additional commit was added to PR30.

PR30 merged with parents
`c45338567700e3048f4cf32d251369e4521e9444` and
`a10fa4450752e82e163f82bcb13f2fcbf7c0cc21`, in that order. Its tree equals the
reviewed tree. The five-file snapshot retains `NOT_ACTIVATED` as frozen bytes;
the separate receipt records actual transition approval. It grants no live call
or publication permission.

## Plan for review

[One-page entry summary](https://github.com/wlvh/SEC_metrics/blob/d3babd0ac0300d68dd58007e38caa2d7b2c27ab4/docs/r4_live/README.md)
lists every source, period, original table window, native local token upper
bound and reference status/value. [Full bindings](https://github.com/wlvh/SEC_metrics/blob/d3babd0ac0300d68dd58007e38caa2d7b2c27ab4/docs/r4_live/pending_plan_review.json)
include source URL/accession/SHA, task/Spec/Requirement identities and Evidence
results. The plan remains `PENDING_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION`, owner authorization
`NOT_ISSUED`, qualification credit `NONE_PLAN_ONLY`, publication credit `NONE`.

- Exact R4 metrics: A03 A04 A09 A11 A12 A13.
- Nine base scoped requests plus three risk-selected stability ordinals = **12**.
- Stability: Citi A03, JPM A09 and BAC A12; each needs a fresh response.
- A09 alternate and both A13 positives use structured-primary routes: **0 calls**.
- NEGATIVE_EXPECTED, NOT_APPLICABLE, QUALITATIVE_ONLY and AMBIGUOUS_EXCLUDED: **0 calls**.
- Automatic retry **0**; response reuse **false**; target12–18, hard cap24.
- Exact-envelope token upper bounds: **13,464–35,972**, within200,000. These are
  local conservative byte estimates; provider-reported actual usage is NOT_RUN.
- All SEC sources already exist. No acquisition, live Run/cycle, production
  freeze/Stage-A, publication, rollback or restore was performed.

The committed command used to prepare the plan was:

```bash
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/vnext_r4_qualification.py plan
```

The plan was created on receipt commit
`c11911b6f9a0ac4b0cc9952fbf49828dac6145a2`; the final commit only persists the
plan and review documents. Existing ancestry checks allow these evidence-only
commits while rejecting production Python changes. Any future owner live
authorization must bind the current PR-C head and this exact plan ID.

## Verification

On merged main: Requirement closure and181 execution-file bindings PASS;
fast32/32 PASS; active R3, exact R2/R1 and14 mirrors PASS. The approved head is
the second merge parent. The full benchmark was not repeated for an identical
merge tree. Commands, rc and logs are in
[preparation verification](https://github.com/wlvh/SEC_metrics/blob/d3babd0ac0300d68dd58007e38caa2d7b2c27ab4/docs/r4_live/preparation_verification.json).

PR-C local fast and capability alignment pass. The persisted plan is independently
revalidated by the existing repository context and plan validator; summary
packing reproduces every provider request SHA using the committed byte builder
and estimator. Socket/provider/SEC probes remain zero. The final native plan
validation returned0 in98.52s; PR-C local fast32/32 passed in9.248s.
[GitHub fast CI passed](https://github.com/wlvh/SEC_metrics/actions/runs/34011812979)
for head `d3babd0ac0300d68dd58007e38caa2d7b2c27ab4`.

Known PR-B baseline debt remains disclosed:12 unchanged legacy uncontrolled
adapter tests fail with `WB3_EXECUTION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`; no whole-repository
green claim is made. R1–R3, the source/metric policies, parser210000, previous
acquisitions and PR22 archive remain unchanged.

## Complete changed files

```text
artifacts/vnext/qualification/r4_scoped/plans/215277ae679bde123e51cf3ce839445e9ef152c5a9f5d0c72f74a2b6618658bd.json
docs/evidence/issue_28_v2_transition_activation.json
docs/r4_live/README.md
docs/r4_live/pending_plan_review.json
docs/r4_live/preparation_verification.json
```

Review boundary: preparation complete, **live execution not authorized**.
Real execution requires a separate `AUTHORIZE_R4_LIVE_EXACT_HEAD` decision;
publication/rollback/restore require later release authorization. Issue28 stays open.
